summary.title: Summary
summary.text: Computer Science student skilled in Python, machine learning, and backend development. Experienced in AI-driven tools including chatbots, ML models, and personalized study assistants.

experience.title: Experience
experience.bullet1: Built a regression model achieving R² = 0.82 for predicting house prices.
experience.bullet2: Developed a multi-turn chatbot using Gemini API.
experience.bullet3: Strengthened debugging, ML workflows, and documentation practices.

smoke_detector.name: 💨Smoke and fire Detector Web App
smoke_detector.bullet1: Developed a smart smoke detection system using ESP32 and Arduino IDE to monitor air quality and detect fire hazards in real-time.
smoke_detector.bullet2: Implemented a dashboard to display air quality data and upload images when smoke is detected.

house_prediction.name: 🏠 House Price Prediction — Regression Model
house_prediction.bullet1: Performed data cleaning, feature engineering, encoding, and regression model training.
house_prediction.bullet2: Enabled predictions based on size, bedrooms, and location.

pharmacy_llm.name: 📚Pharmacy LLM
pharmacy_llm.bullet1: Engineered a specialized large language model for pharmaceutical and medical queries, ensuring responses adhere to professional medical standards.
pharmacy_llm.bullet2: Fine-tuned the model on pharmaceutical textbooks and medical references to enhance domain knowledge and accuracy.
pharmacy_llm.bullet3: Optimized the models inference performance to ensure reliable, high-integrity responses regarding drug compositions and usages.
